 bet365 Nations League preview
 There are plenty of highlights to look forward to, as the Nations League group stage draws to a dramatic conclusion. Here we’ll focus on Sunday night’s clash between Spain and England.
 UEFA Nations League Preview – Spain vs England: Sunday, 7.45pm
 Spain have won all five of their group games and sit top on 15 points. England are three behind on 12, so a win in Madrid would level them on points. England have already booked their quarter-final place, which leaves top spot as the prize and a bit of pride after the Wembley defeat in September.
 That night was a rollercoaster. Lamine Yamal had Spain ahead inside two minutes, then Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane turned it round before the break. After half-time Kane slipped taking a penalty and hit the bar, and Spain made them pay. Alex Baena and Mikel Oyarzabal scored the goals that won it 3-2. England’s attacking play was good, but their defending cost them.
 Both sides arrive in good shape. England have won four from five in the group, scoring 16 and conceding four. They beat Croatia 2-1 on Thursday, though Jarell Quansah’s mistake let Croatia level and Kane had to win it from the penalty spot, ensuring victory despite a generally flat display.
 Spain have scored 14 and conceded five, and looked more comfortable in Prague, beating 10-man Czechia 2-0 through a Baena penalty and a late Marc Pubill strike.
 Expect another entertaining game, with Spain fancied to edge things on their own patch.
